whyMatters.en: Queens, NYC band that compressed rock’n’roll into two-minute, downstroked bursts; Ramones (1976) is the US punk timing blueprint.
whyMatters.zh: 纽约皇后区：把摇滚压成两分钟下行扫弦爆发；Ramones（1976）是美国朋克时值蓝图。

note.en: 1-2-3-4 count-in; downstroke wall; two-minute US punk blueprint.
note.zh: 1-2-3-4 起拍；下行扫弦墙；两分钟美国朋克蓝图。
皮衣速度下的泡泡糖旋律。

note.en: Marky-era Road to Ruin; still short-song discipline.
note.zh: Marky 时期 Road to Ruin；仍守短歌纪律。

interviewQuotes.text: I don't play leads. I don't want to play leads.
interviewQuotes.speaker: Johnny Ramone

shortBio.en: Joey / Johnny / Dee Dee / Tommy then Marky; Blitzkrieg Bop teaches the count-in.
shortBio.zh: Joey / Johnny / Dee Dee / Tommy，后换 Marky；Blitzkrieg Bop 教会起拍。

body.en:
Formed 1974. Early Sire albums (Ramones, Leave Home, Rocket to Russia) fixed leather-jacket image, Joey’s deadpan vocal, Johnny’s strict downstrokes, Dee Dee’s bass count-ins.

Blitzkrieg Bop (1976) is the essential cue. Influence is structural—short songs, few chords, high tempo—absorbed by UK punk, hardcore, and later pop-punk.
body.zh:
1974 年组建。早期 Sire 专辑（Ramones、Leave Home、Rocket to Russia）定型皮衣形象、Joey 的冷脸人声、Johnny 的严格下行扫弦、Dee Dee 的贝斯起拍。

Blitzkrieg Bop（1976）是必听提示。影响是结构层面——短歌、少和弦、高速度——被英国朋克、hardcore 与后来的流行朋克吸收。

body.en:
Ramones compress rock’n’roll into short songs, open chords, and Johnny’s strict downstrokes. CBGB-era New York timing becomes the US punk default that UK bands accelerate further.

Few leads; high tempo; leather as uniform.
body.zh:
Ramones 把摇滚压成短歌、开放和弦与 Johnny 严格下行扫弦。CBGB 时期纽约时值成为美国朋克默认，英国乐队再提速。

少独奏；高速度；皮衣作制服。

body.en:
Tommy Ramone drums the 1976–77 Sire documents, then produces. Marky joins 1978 for Road to Ruin onward. Joey/Johnny/Dee Dee remain the vocal-guitar-bass constant through the classic years.

Lineup Versions mark the drum chair, not a genre pivot.
body.zh:
Tommy Ramone 鼓上 1976–77 Sire 文献，后转制作。Marky 1978 加入，自 Road to Ruin 起。Joey/Johnny/Dee Dee 在经典年仍是人声-吉他-贝斯常量。

阵容版本标记鼓席，不是流派转向。

body.en:
Dee Dee’s 1-2-3-4, Joey’s hey-ho chant, Johnny’s chord wall. Under three minutes. It is the track teachers and cover bands still use to explain US punk timing.

Judy Is a Punk sits beside it on the debut as the short-song twin.
body.zh:
Dee Dee 的 1-2-3-4、Joey 的 hey-ho 口号、Johnny 的和弦墙。不到三分钟。仍是教师与翻唱乐队解释美国朋克时值的曲目。

Judy Is a Punk 在首专旁作短歌双生。

body.en:
Joey: tall deadpan lead. Johnny: Mosrite/downstroke discipline, no solos by policy. Dee Dee: bass and many early lyrics/count-ins.

Chemistry is rigid method, not jam culture.
body.zh:
Joey：高个冷脸主唱。Johnny：Mosrite/下行扫弦纪律，原则上不独奏。Dee Dee：贝斯与许多早期歌词/起拍。

化学反应是刚性方法，不是即兴文化。

body.en:
Joey’s “happy family” refrain and Johnny’s no-leads rule document brand and technique. Read them against the Sire tracking speeds.

Quotes are method evidence.
body.zh:
Joey 的「快乐家庭」口头禅与 Johnny 的无独奏规则记录品牌与技术。对照 Sire 跟录速度阅读。

引语是方法证据。

title.en: UK punk and hardcore absorb the timing
title.zh: 英国朋克与 hardcore 吸收时值

body.en:
Sex Pistols and The Clash take the short-song energy into UK tabloid and political lanes. Later hardcore and pop-punk keep the count-in and downstroke grammar.

Structural influence outlives the leather image.
body.zh:
Sex Pistols 与 The Clash 把短歌能量带进英国小报与政治车道。后来 hardcore 与流行朋克保留起拍与下行扫弦语法。

结构影响比皮衣形象活得更久。

note.en: Debut through Rocket to Russia; US punk timing blueprint.
note.zh: 首专至 Rocket to Russia；美国朋克时值蓝图。

note.en: Road to Ruin onward; Dee Dee exits 1989, later bassists continue tours.
note.zh: 自 Road to Ruin；Dee Dee 1989 离队，后期贝斯手续巡演。

note.en: Count-in + downstroke as US punk timing lesson.
note.zh: 起拍 + 下行扫弦作为美国朋克时值课。

note.en: Short songs, few chords, high tempo as export method.
note.zh: 短歌、少和弦、高速度作为出口方法。
